# ferentin_mcp_scope_defaults_scopes (Data Source)

List every scope with MCP scope defaults of its own — one `ferentin_mcp_scope_defaults` per scope: the tenant default first, then each device group that has its own posture row. A group with no row of its own runs the tenant default's and is not listed.

The defaults are an API over the endpoint posture row, so a scope here is also a row of `ferentin_endpoint_policy_settings_scopes`, and the two share `version`. The scope defaults carry no provenance of their own; that row's `managed_by` is the one to check.

Every item carries `import_id`, the ID `ferentin_mcp_scope_defaults`' `import` block takes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The MCP scope defaults of the tenant default and of every device group with a
# posture row of its own.
data "ferentin_mcp_scope_defaults_scopes" "all" {}

# Scopes still rehearsing their server approval default.
output "rehearsing_server_approval" {
  value = [for s in data.ferentin_mcp_scope_defaults_scopes.all.scopes : coalesce(s.device_group_id, "tenant default") if s.server_approval_mode == "report_only"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant to list. Defaults to the provider's.

### Read-Only

- `scopes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scopes))

<a id="nestedatt--scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scopes`

Read-Only:

- `device_group_id` (String) The device group. Null on the tenant default.
- `import_id` (String) `<tenant_id>` for the tenant default, `<tenant_id>/<device_group_id>` for a group.
- `server_approval` (String)
- `server_approval_mode` (String)
- `source` (String) `device_group`, `tenant` or `built_in`: where the values come from.
- `tool_vetting_mode` (String) The scope's own value; `inherit` or null on a group that follows the tenant's.
- `unattributed` (String)
- `unattributed_mode` (String)
- `version` (Number) The posture row's version. Null for a tenant with no posture row yet.
